Adds `research/conformal-tolerance`: distribution-free calibration of drift tolerances for verifiable ML training.

- Exact false-slash law of split-conformal thresholds; only ~51-56% of calibration sets are <= alpha
- PAC calibration size n >= ln(delta)/ln(1-alpha) (459 at 1%/1%)
- Hiding-room inflation of the PAC threshold for Pareto drift
- Gaussian plug-in misspecification; pooled vs per-hardware calibration
- Emulated float32 Freivalds residual check
- 7 stdlib-only tests pass; README and portfolio page updated
